ns2:course.label: The Dynamic Earth-Honors
ns2:course.description: (GEOL 111) Study of the geological history and evolution of the earth, the formation of mountains and ocean basins, the making of continents and earth environments and resources. Typically, a three to four-day field trip is required. Course in the Campus Honors Program. Credit may not be received for both GEOL 111 and GEOL 100, GEOL 101, GEOL 103, or GEOL 107.
